name: mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB
description: Community-sourced database of game controller mappings for SDL2 and SDL3, providing button/axis mappings for hundreds of controllers across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
score_rationale: Indispensable SDL controller mapping database with 1.7k stars, continuously updated by the community, and integrated into virtually every SDL-based game for out-of-the-box controller support.
summary: Community controller mapping database for SDL games
